_comment: The watchlist. Employer ATS boards first, aggregators second.
Reading an employer's own board is the highest-signal source there is: if the
posting is on the company's board today, the search is live. That is what the
`signal` field in CONTRACT.md is for.
To find a company's token, open their careers page and read the URL:
job-boards.greenhouse.io/TOKEN     -> type greenhouse
jobs.ashbyhq.com/TOKEN             -> type ashby
jobs.lever.co/TOKEN                -> type lever
apply.workable.com/TOKEN           -> type workable
jobs.smartrecruiters.com/TOKEN     -> type smartrecruiters
VERIFIED 2026-08-03 against the live endpoints. Every token below returned
HTTP 200, and the posting count at the time is recorded on each line so a
board that silently empties is visible as a change rather than as a quiet
morning. This replaces the previous UNVERIFIED note: the tokens had never
been confirmed because the sandbox they were written in blocked job-board
hosts, and one of the seven was wrong the whole time.
Tried and FAILED, recorded so nobody re-adds them:
greenhouse/notion   404. Notion is on Ashby, and this wrong token meant the
board was silently skipped on every run until 2026-08-03.
ashby/glean         404. Glean is on Greenhouse as `gleanwork`.
greenhouse/sierraai 404. Sierra is on Ashby as `sierra`.
ashby/hebbia        404. Board not found, needs its careers page read.
greenhouse/etsy     404. Needs its careers page read.
greenhouse/plaid    404. Needs its careers page read.
WHY THE LIST IS THIS LONG. The watchlist is the ceiling on the digest. Seven
employers cannot produce the 15 to 20 postings prompts/daily-search.md asks
for, and on 2026-08-03 a nine-role morning read as a thin market when it was
actually a short watchlist plus a broken token.
The second block is deliberately NOT AI-native. prompts/profile.md says that
for the Tier 2 GTM family ANY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY COUNTS, so a watchlist of
only model labs starves the GTM family and Tier 3 entirely. That is why the
same morning returned two GTM roles and zero PM roles.
A large board will not come back through a page fetcher: OpenAI's is over
11MB and a 10MB limit fails it silently. fetch_jobs.py streams, so it is
unaffected, but an agent reading a board by hand must use curl.
Set enabled to false rather than deleting, so the watchlist stays readable.
See SOURCES.md for why LinkedIn and Indeed are not in this list.

sources._group: Model labs and AI platforms. Tier 1 lives here.
AI-native application companies with a New York presence. Tier 1 deployment and CS.
Technology companies, not AI-native. For the Tier 2 GTM family, where profile.md says any technology company counts, and for Tier 3.
